name: Ambiguous unlabeled media clarification and beginner slot onboarding
prompt: Here are 3 images and 1 audio file. Make a MiniMax H3 video where the hero walks through a ruined temple and says a line.

judge.check: The agent recognizes missing duration (no <Video N> to derive from) and structural ambiguity (whether Image 1 locks frame 0 vs character appearance, what Images 2-3 represent, and whether Audio 1 is copied or voice-timbre only), asking once in plain English with exact H3 5+17k (24fps) length options or complexity-matched duration ranges without internal preset jargon.
Once answered or when proposing defaults, the agent explains exact Media Wiring for Picture 1..3 and Audio 1 plus adaptive beat-based duration/segment choices in beginner-friendly terms.
